metadata.title: High-Contrast Asymmetric Portrait with Interlocking Block Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A dramatic, high-contrast portrait cropped to one side of the face, paired with a three-tiered interlocking block typographic layout in the negative space.
triggerTerms: desaturated face with dark negative space

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, desaturated close-up of a male face occupying the right half of the frame, with the left half consisting of deep black negative space containing a three-line typographic stack where the letters interlock and overlap vertically.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme right-side facial crop vs. left-side negative space
Desaturated skin tones vs. muted earth-tone typography
Sharp eye focus vs. soft beard texture
Geometric block text vs. organic facial contours
coreInvariants: The subject's right eye must be the primary focal point on the right vertical third.
Typography must be stacked in three distinct horizontal tiers with vertical overlap.
The background must be a solid, dark, textured black.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up of the right side of a face, scaled to fill the entire vertical height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye, positioned in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eye, moves down the facial texture, then shifts left to the typographic block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black void on the left half of the composition.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted ochre and teal for the primary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across all elements; high value contrast between the face and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, ochre, and teal

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning with zero letter spacing
Vertical interlocking where descenders of one line touch or overlap ascenders of the next
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' and 'E' in the second line are tucked into the 'T' of the first line
The 'A' and 'L' in the third line are merged or tightly overlapped
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a light, spaced-out secondary font and a heavy, interlocking primary font.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and clean terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated portrait of a man's face, cropped so only the right half is visible. The left half should be a solid, slightly textured black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of text in the black area. The top line in small white sans-serif. The bottom two lines in large, heavy, interlocking block letters, using ochre for the middle line and teal for the bottom line.

verificationChecks: Is the face cropped to the right side?
Do the large letters interlock vertically?
Is the color palette restricted to ochre, teal, white, and black?

mustAchieve: Deep, true blacks in the negative space

postGenerationChecks: Check that the eye is positioned in the upper right third.
Ensure the text does not touch the facial features.
Verify the interlocking nature of the block letters.
Confirm the desaturated, near-monochrome skin tone.
recipe.reuseFormula: Asymmetric Portrait + Negative Space + Interlocking Block Typography
